decision_constraints.label: Use Effect for the common TypeScript layer.
CLI/MCP call one complete operation implementation.
Share feature logic and React UI wherever targets support it.
Retain existing native product hosts during migration.
Preserve historical contracts while versioning the selected expansion separately.
Keep one Health.md product with separately authorized health/location/device_usage domains.
Reuse the full Health.md operation/export/schedule/delivery engine.
Capture through native sources independently of React lifecycle.
Preserve observed, aggregated, corrected and inferred meanings.
Import donors deliberately and retain rollback.
Offer optional hosted storage through the common destination/source model.
Disclose server-readable custody and qualify actual regional controls.
Separate upload, account and agent grants.
Qualify named clients and cloud lifecycle before claims or rollout.

risk_obligations.label: Signed Node distribution and OS credential principal
Safe destinations and cross-process state
Effect/RN/Hermes/Web/macOS version and runtime compatibility
Headless/background/intent startup and lifecycle
Exact binary64/integer/time/Unicode/serializer behavior
Channel licensing/privacy/build-time exclusions
Old engine pins, journals, acknowledgements and downgrade
Actual CI/test/disk benefit and runtime costs
Public Rust consumer/install retirement and external CI settings
Scope omissions hidden by a broad “shared UI” claim
macOS title/collector permission and sandbox/channel incompatibility
iOS usage production eligibility, purpose and export destinations
Lossless donor identity/history/entitlement migration
Continuous capture energy, storage and retention
False equivalence and duplicate totals across domains/devices
Full history versus source/API losses
Cross-tenant access, oversized history and cloud authority confusion
Region, key, backup and erasure claims exceed actual controls
Agent compatibility, downstream copies and source-purpose restrictions
Hosted cost/capacity, billing and rollout failure
